data.description:
## Summary

rebar documents a relocatable ticket store as a supported feature, then bypasses its own
resolver in dozens of shipped code paths, each assuming the store sits at
`repo_root/.tickets-tracker`. Any deployment that relocates the store — which the deployed MCP
server does — breaks in those paths, with errors that name a path the operator never configured.

## The contract that is being ignored

`src/rebar/config.py:138-156` (`tracker_dir()`) is explicit: the env override
`REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` 'wins verbatim'; otherwise the configured `tracker.dir` applies, where 'an
absolute value relocates the store (EV-3b)'. Relocation is a FEATURE, not an edge case.

## The bypass

`grep -c '.tickets-tracker' src/rebar/**/*.py` => **76** occurrences. Representative call sites
that hardcode rather than resolve:

- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/last_pass.py:89` — `path = repo_root / ".tickets-tracker" / ".env-id"`
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/last_pass.py:35` — `DETAIL_RELATIVE = Path(".tickets-tracker/.bridge_state/last-pass.json")`
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/git_adapter.py:75` — `TRACKER_DIR = ".tickets-tracker"`
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/runtime.py:44` — `_DEFAULT_TRACKER_DIR = ".tickets-tracker"`
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/dispatch_one.py:321` — `(repo_root or _owned_repo_root()) / ".tickets-tracker"`
- `_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py:508` — `resolved_root / ".tickets-tracker"`
- `_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py:586`, `_snapshot/ticket_view.py:73`, `_bridge_runner.py:180`,
  `llm/config.py:317`

## Observed failure (reported from a live Copilot session)

    bridge_status -> command_failed, exit 1
    "cannot read bridge status: cannot read local environment id from
     /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code/.tickets-tracker/.env-id: [Errno 2] No such file or directory"

The deployed server sets `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets`. The store is there and
is healthy — 2763 tickets are readable through the same server. `last_pass.py:89` never consults
that variable, so it looks under `repo_root` instead and reports a path nobody configured.

## Attribution — checked, NOT caused by the recent MCP code-root change

Gerrit 2271 set `REBAR_ROOT=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code` on this container. That CHANGED the wrong
path being reported but did not create the fault:

- before 2271: `REBAR_ROOT` unset -> `repo_root` fell back to cwd `/app` -> the code looked for
  `/app/.tickets-tracker`, which cannot exist (`.dockerignore` excludes `.tickets-tracker`);
- after 2271: it looks under `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code` instead.

Both are wrong, for the same reason: neither honours `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR`. The bug predates 2271
and would survive its revert.

## Why this is a portability defect, not a deployment quirk

Nothing project- or operator-specific belongs in shipped rebar code. A consumer who relocates the
store — a supported configuration — gets failures in the reconciler, snapshot, and bridge paths
with no indication that their configured location was ignored. The single resolver
(`config.tracker_dir()`) already exists; these call sites simply do not use it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Shipped code resolves the store through `config.tracker_dir()` (or an equivalent single
      seam) rather than composing `repo_root / ".tickets-tracker"`.
- [ ] `bridge_status` succeeds against a relocated store, and `.env-id` is read from the
      configured location.
- [ ] A regression test runs a representative path with `REBAR_TRACKER_DIR` pointing OUTSIDE the
      repo root and fails if the hardcoded name is reintroduced.
- [ ] A lint/grep gate rejects new `repo_root / ".tickets-tracker"` constructions in `src/`, so
      the 76 occurrences cannot quietly regrow after they are drained.

## Note on scope

Some of the 76 are legitimate (the DEFAULT NAME in `config.py:154`, `_config_schema.py:631`, and
docstrings). The defect is the call sites that skip the resolver, not every mention of the
string.
data.title: Shipped code hardcodes repo_root/.tickets-tracker, so a relocated store (a SUPPORTED feature) silently breaks
